# openprovider_ssl_order (Resource)

Manages an SSL/TLS certificate order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openprovider_ssl_order" "www" {
  product_id  = 7
  common_name = "www.example.com"

  # Your own certificate signing request. Without one, OpenProvider generates
  # a key pair and you do not hold the private key.
  csr = file("${path.module}/www.example.com.csr")

  domain_validation_method = "dns"
}

# Empty until the order is active.
output "certificate" {
  value = openprovider_ssl_order.www.certificate
}

output "certificate_chain" {
  value = "${openprovider_ssl_order.www.intermediate_certificate}${openprovider_ssl_order.www.root_certificate}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `common_name` (String) The common name (CN) for the SSL certificate (primary domain).
- `product_id` (Number) The SSL product ID to order.

### Optional

- `additional_domains` (List of String) List of additional domains to include in the SSL certificate (SANs).
- `admin_handle` (String) The handle/ID of the administrative contact.
- `autorenew` (Boolean) Enable automatic renewal of the SSL certificate.
- `billing_handle` (String) The handle/ID of the billing contact.
- `csr` (String) A certificate signing request (PEM) for the order. Without one, OpenProvider generates a key pair and a request, and you do not hold the private key. A change replaces the order, which is charged again. When the order is imported, the request that OpenProvider holds is read into the state, and a request that differs only in whitespace is no change.
- `domain_validation_method` (String) The method used to validate domain ownership (dns, http, email, etc.).
- `owner_handle` (String) The handle/ID of the certificate owner contact.
- `technical_handle` (String) The handle/ID of the technical contact.

### Read-Only

- `active_date` (String) The date and time when the certificate became active.
- `brand_name` (String) The brand name of the SSL certificate.
- `certificate` (String) The issued certificate (PEM). Empty until the order is active.
- `expiration_date` (String) The date and time when the certificate expires.
- `id` (Number) The SSL order identifier.
- `intermediate_certificate` (String) The intermediate certificate (PEM) of the chain. Empty until the order is active.
- `order_date` (String) The date and time when the order was placed.
- `root_certificate` (String) The root certificate (PEM) of the chain. Empty until the order is active.
- `status` (String) The current status of the SSL order.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An order is imported by its numeric id, as the openprovider_ssl_orders data source lists it.
terraform import openprovider_ssl_order.www 12345
```
